hero.lead: To keep industrial facilities running safely and efficiently, Adanex Elektrik provides all the explosion-proof products and electrical equipment they need, with a professional engineering approach.

projects.zoneNote: Zone classification and product selection must be carried out by competent specialists for your specific facility.

lighting.title: Explosion-Proof Lighting Fixtures
lighting.summary: The fixtures are designed for safe use in line with the ATEX directives. Explosion-proof lighting and emergency exit fixtures provide maximum safety and long-lasting performance in demanding industrial conditions. With solutions that meet international standards, Adanex Elektrik is the address of trust on every project.

controlBoxes.title: Explosion-Proof Control Boxes
controlBoxes.summary: The boxes offer solutions tailored to your needs, with variants such as Start, Stop, Emergency Stop, Locking Emergency Stop, red/green signal lamps and cam switches. The durable aluminium enclosure provides maximum safety and long-lasting performance in explosive atmospheres.

emergencyExit.title: Explosion-Proof Emergency Exit Fixtures
emergencyExit.summary: Exit, emergency exit and emergency kit fixture options offer maximum protection and long-lasting performance in explosive atmospheres. Adanex Elektrik delivers reliable solutions for critical industrial projects.

cableGlands.title: E1W Explosion-Proof Armoured Brass Cable Gland
cableGlands.summary: Playing a critical role at the connection points of armoured cables, explosion-proof cable glands ensure the safe termination of cables. Zone‑1 D type products in particular raise operators' safety standards in the highest-risk environments with an explosion-resistant design. The glands offer sealing, maximum safety and long-lasting performance at high temperatures and in demanding industrial conditions. Durable material options such as brass, stainless steel and nickel plating address different needs. From refineries and petrochemical plants to paint and chemical factories and power stations, they support operators' production continuity across a wide range of applications. Supplied with the Adanex Elektrik assurance, these cable glands are not just a connection element but a strategic investment that strengthens an industrial safety culture.

floodlights.title: Zone 2/22 Explosion-Proof LED Floodlights
floodlights.summary: The explosion-proof LED floodlight design is developed to provide safe light in explosive gas and dust environments. Its impact-resistant housing delivers durability in demanding conditions. It can be used in high-risk areas such as refineries, petrochemical plants, paint and chemical factories, food production areas, the pharmaceutical industry and power stations. While its explosion-proof construction supports operators' production continuity, high product quality provides long-term performance. With its explosion-proof floodlight and lighting solutions, Adanex Elektrik delivers maximum safety in industrial facilities and helps operators improve their energy efficiency.

panels.title: Explosion-Proof Panels and Junction Boxes
panels.summary:
Explosion-proof panels and junction boxes are flameproof enclosures designed to safely house electrical connections in explosive gas and dust environments. They prevent any arc or spark that may occur inside from spreading to the surrounding atmosphere.

Compact terminal boxes are offered for small terminal connections, and large-volume aluminium-bodied panel models, optionally with a glass window, for control equipment such as contactors, relays and PLCs.

Refineries, LNG/LPG facilities, the chemical industry, paint shops and gas filling sites are the main areas of use. For the model, dimension and internal volume table, <anchor>explore Adanex explosion-proof panel models</anchor>.
